summary: Queue location is blank when the login location is not queue-tagged
description:
When creating a queue entry in the Service Queues app, the Queue Location field remains blank if the login location is not queue-tagged, even when it has a queue-tagged ancestor.
The Service Queues dashboard correctly resolves and selects the nearest queue-tagged ancestor. The form still defaults to the login location, which isn't among its dropdown options, leaving the field blank.
Steps to reproduce:
Log into the application at a location that is not queue-tagged but has a queue-tagged parent or ancestor.

Navigate to Service Queues and confirm that the dashboard shows the queue-tagged ancestor.

Open the Add patient to queue form for a patient with an active visit.

Observe the Queue Location field.

Expected behavior: The Queue Location field defaults to the location selected in Service Queues, with the session location as fallback when no queue location is selected.
Actual behavior: The field is blank, requiring manual selection.
The cause is a mismatch between the form's default location and its available options, rather than an asynchronous delay in loading the session location.
Fix: PR #2731 uses the selected Service Queues location as the form default. Verified in the local app: the original code leaves the field blank, the patched code selects the queue-tagged ancestor, and manually clearing the field keeps it cleared.
